# vize_atelier_ssr_composed

`vize_atelier_ssr_composed` is the source of [`vize_atelier_ssr`](../vize_atelier_ssr) compiled
again, with `sfc_map_copy!` keeping its `composed` tokens. Its SSR compile records the render maps the SFC assembly composes.
Hosts reach it only when they compose a render map, so a compile without one
runs `vize_atelier_ssr` unchanged.

Do not edit this crate. Edit `vize_atelier_ssr` and run `node tools/commands/generate/composed-crates.ts`.

Support and deprecation guarantees are defined in the
[Rust crate support tiers](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/blob/main/docs/content/stability.md#rust-crate-support-tiers).
